# VelocTech Inc.

> VelocTech Inc. is a software engineering studio in Islamabad, Pakistan.

VelocTech Inc. (VelocTech) builds production web applications, eCommerce platforms, and AI-powered products using Next.js, React, TypeScript, and modern cloud architecture.

- Website: set via production deployment
- Contact: hello@veloctech.com
- Location: Islamabad, Pakistan
- AI assistant: Villi AI (on-site chat)

## Primary pages

- Home: portfolio, about, skills, projects, testimonials, contact
- Chat: Villi AI assistant (explore services and work)
